trickyParts: GitHub reported the PR CONFLICTING: #2182 merged at 158654c89e8b with its edit of the middle sentence of the same AGENTS.md row. Resolved by forward merge (fc8dc19f), keeping #2182's middle sentence and this issue's last sentence. Fingerprint 2dc5cf58... -> 524490ef... (changed only because the row's removed and added lines both carry #2182's sentence); comment https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/2190#issuecomment-6395756802.

The ruling's first stated mechanism ('the pod's own namespace') is not what kubectl does: client-go's in-cluster namespace is POD_NAMESPACE, else the projected serviceaccount namespace file, else default. In this deployment the operator projects that file from ConfigMap legion-kube-namespace naming the workload's namespace, so the unflagged gate reads as working. The architect ruled (envoy f4a5138e) to write the measured mechanism and to change only the 'no command here passes -n' claim, not the sequence.
